characters.name: wesker
characters.title: Frontal Assault
characters.description: Albert Wesker brings a god complex and a body rebuilt by the virus: crush the battlefield with the Grav Slam and reach any vantage with the Grapple Gun.
characters.head: c_t8_wesker_face

texts.hash_438e8b2f52f5538b: Former S.T.A.R.S. captain and Umbrella researcher, reborn by the virus he carries…
texts.hash_2299bc20d2a6cd8:
Albert Wesker was raised by Umbrella as one of the Wesker Children, a project to breed the next generation of humanity.

As captain of the S.T.A.R.S. Alpha Team he led his own men into the Arklay mansion as test subjects, and was killed by the Tyrant he set loose. The prototype virus he had injected brought him back stronger, faster and colder than any man.

Working in the shadows of Tricell, he now pursues Uroboros: a virus to winnow mankind down to the few he deems worthy. To him the battlefield is a test, and few pass it.

characters.name: kagan
characters.title: The Guild
characters.description: Emma Kagan, head of The Guild, turns every fight into a market she owns: flatten positions with the War Machine and flush cover with the Cluster Grenade.
characters.head: c_t8_kagan_head

texts.hash_438e8b2f52f5538b: The head of The Guild: a market in every war, a lesson in every fight.
texts.hash_2299bc20d2a6cd8:
Emma Kagan runs The Guild, a private defense giant whose technology reaches every battlefield. She does not ask for loyalty; she buys it, and she collects on every debt.

Where others see a war, she sees a market and a test of who is worth keeping. Every operator who stands against her is a lesson, and every lesson has a cost.

texts.hash_438e8b2f52f5538b: A silent killer in a rooster mask, speaking only through his tapes.
texts.hash_2299bc20d2a6cd8:
Nobody knows his name. In Miami, 1989, the phone rang with a message on the machine, and a man in a letterman jacket put on a rooster mask and went to work.

Years later he turned up with the Payday crew: he never says a word of his own, only what his cassette tapes say for him - ads, nature shows, self-help, airline greetings. The crew stopped asking. The job always gets done.
